participants.population: University of Virginia undergraduate economics students

symmetric_baseline.note: The paper reports three baseline symmetric sessions. Three additional symmetric sessions used public draws and are outside this adapter's evidence-complete scope.

steps: Select urn A or urn B with equal probability.
Generate one private light or dark draw with replacement for each of six participants.
Randomize the order in which the six participants decide.
Ask each participant to predict urn A or urn B after showing only their private draw and earlier public predictions.
Announce each prediction before approaching the next participant.
Reveal the true urn after all six predictions and award $2 to each correct participant.
